reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from *Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth* (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages with their bay numbers when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support fixed it that evening, and Thea confirmed the 04:00 shift on 5 Oct got through the gate without anyone stepping in. The note also says the kiosk logs should be archived before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from *Moss: North cheat sheet* (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). This note has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It was passed up to the second tier of product support so they could test the scanner software.

**What I left out:**
- **#4409, #4412 and FR-882**, from the Central notes. They belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.
- **Quarendon Freightways** (one "r"). The cheat sheet says it's a different company and not one of our customers.

**Where I looked:** the six Moss notes in the shared files you can open, four North and two Central. Neither of the other two North notes, the 14 Sep pipeline digest and the 23 Mar renewal check-in, has a Quarrendon ticket number. I didn't look in any Quarrendon account folders, because none show up in the files you can see. If there are Moss notes stored somewhere else, I couldn't see them.
